title: Correlating It All: ILM · Romenagri · PEDLER · QEDLER · DNA Compiler
subtitle: Linguistic identity, executable transformation and substrate-independent computation in one architecture

blocks.text: ILM supplies the identity layer (script ≠ language ≠ representation; one canonical identity, many script projections); PEDLER supplies the executable walk. Romenagri is explicitly NOT romanisation but a canonical, reversible linguistic identity with an 84-entry phonological basis and a historical toolchain (acii2rmn.c forward, rmn2acii.c recursive-descent reverse, flatten_uni_dev canonicalisation). Script types become parameterised representation grammars — alphabet, abjad, abugida — realised by Render_S(C, V, θ_S).

blocks.explanation: Panel 10 turns a nuisance into a feature. Where an abjad underspecifies vowels, multiple candidate expansions exist and PEDLER represents all of them with inclinations, selecting by max-I, softmax, utility or contextual Bayesian methods. The stated insight — ambiguity is not an error, it is a state with multiple viable transitions — is what lets the architecture avoid the N² transliteration explosion by parameterising instead of enumerating.
